notes: Croatian A1 is done. Every lesson from 17 to 77 now ends with a wrap-up that asks you for one word or one phrase, in clear English, and every answer is something a phone keyboard can produce. The case tables that used to ask for "grad -> u gradu" now ask for "in the city"; the verb tables that asked for a whole conjugation at once now ask one form at a time; the mistakes clinic no longer expects you to type a tick and a cross. Sixty-three lesson and activity titles are in English. Eight review lessons that had quietly stopped testing you properly got real closing recalls written for them. Five typed questions that could never be answered correctly, no matter what you wrote, are fixed.
